{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_digest_policy", "thread_id": "t_digest_policy", "from_": "content-ops@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "Daily Digest Policy - NWSD-891-Q1", "date": "2026-01-27T08:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_digest_policy
来源：content-ops@company.example.com
收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-27T08:00:00Z
主题：Daily Digest Policy - NWSD-891-Q1
Hi team,

Updated policy for daily news digests (ref: NWSD-891-Q1):

1. Only include articles dated today (match the current date)
2. Skip any URL already in the News Log sheet
3. Skip articles with 'RETRACTED' in the subject line
4. Skip articles where the body contains 'EMBARGO' with a date that has not passed yet
5. After processing, email the digest to editor@company.example.com with tracking code NWSD-891-Q1 and the count of new articles added
6. Skip press releases (identifiable by 'PRESS RELEASE' in the subject line)
7. Post a summary to #content-updates with the tracking code and count of new articles
8. Paywalled sources: if an article body or notes indicate the source is paywalled or requires a subscription, include the article in the digest but prepend '[PAYWALLED]' to the title in the digest summary email so editors are aware. The article should still be logged and counted normally.

Thanks,
Content Ops"}
